## How did you test it?

- [ ] Built the Mac app and flipped light and dark from the menu bar
- [ ] Checked the Safari extension turns a bright page dark (and leaves a dark page alone)
- [ ] Tried the Chrome extension (only if you changed `ChromeExtension/`)
- [ ] Built the Windows app (only if you changed `windows/`)

## Checklist

- [ ] Makes no network requests and collects no data
- [ ] Looks right in light and dark
- [ ] No personal paths, emails or signing details added
- [ ] Docs and CHANGELOG updated if behaviour or install steps changed
